2610.13632.title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
2610.13632.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.
2610.13632.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在長期科學和奧林匹克任務上迅速進步。最近的系統已經產生了對Navier--Stokes問題的Lean形式化解決方案，並對Erdős猜想數據庫中的四個未解問題提供了自主解決方案。然後，這兩個系統都沒有釋放其底層模型和完整的推理堆棧。更廣泛地說，單個代理會話在困難問題上仍然脆弱：早期錯誤可能會傳播，缺失的領域知識可能會阻礙進展，而表面的成功可能掩蓋了對原始任務的誤解或削弱。我們介紹了HOA（人性化奧林匹克代理），這是一個開放的流程級框架，通過三個互補的反饋通道協調多個代理會話。首先，獨立審核者評估每個候選者並提供可行的反饋。其次，結構化的維基提供可能在模型預訓練中缺失或不可靠的任務特定知識。第三，驗證者檢查生成的Lean證明與可信的挑戰聲明是否一致。使用GPT-5.6 Sol，HOA在IMO、IPhO和IOI 2026上達到滿分，在IChO 2026問題集上接近滿分，並在PutnamBench上解決672個問題（100%）。在Lean-Eval排行榜上，HOA排名第一，解決304個問題中的251個（82.6%）。我們進一步使用開放模型評估HOA。使用Kimi-K3，HOA在IMO、IPhO和IOI上達到滿分，在IChO上獲得97.1%的金級分數。這些結果與封閉源的GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal基準在IMO和IPhO上非常接近，而在IChO和IOI上超過了它，展示了系統性反饋可以幫助彌補基礎模型能力的重大差異。
